Oneliner

Joins Open Cosmos' OpenConstellation to advance the use of AI and IoT in Earth Observation
Description

Accenture-1 was developed with Accenture and had funding by European Space Agency - ESA via the Scale-up Invest programme, in collaboration with the UK Space Agency.

It joins our OpenConstellation to advance the use of AI and IoT in Earth Observation, processing hyperspectral data in orbit to unlock new insights for agriculture, energy, and environmental management.
